description: Live interoperability (Phase 8): one shared HL7 v2 module (app.hl7), an interface outbox fed in the same transaction as ADT events / order signings / lab releases, a real MLLP listener service (app.mllp_server) that routes inbound ORU^R01 into the existing lab ingest (drafts only) and records inbound ADT as external events with conflict refusal (never mutating census), a retrying dispatcher with dead letters + replay, public-health ELR reporting from the published reportable-conditions list, and FHIR bulk ($export-style) NDJSON jobs behind the interop.export capability. Endpoints, retry policy, facility identity and the reportable list are Studio configuration (integration/hl7-endpoints, terminology/reportable-conditions), seeded as published v1 with all endpoints disabled.
name: interop
